title: Dragon Ball Z: Budokai Tenkaichi 3 (Europe/Australia, PAL)
required_inputs: validation that the splat-derived DBZP overlay map matches PAL runtime hooks
notes: The boot ELF and its 7-program VU1 manifest are verified against the ELF's VIF MPG stream. The function map and the DBZP overlay map are splat-derived into the ignored per-variant work directory. The overlay is generated with gen_overlay.py --simple: the USA re-entry-label and gap-stitch tables are USA addresses and are not applied.
